title: Fugue in G major

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in the soprano, a turn, then leaps to a half cadence.
☞ The answer in the alto, on D.
☞ The bass enters with the subject, on G.
☞ The subject turned upside down, in the alto.
☞ The inversion in the soprano, from A.
☞ The inversion in the bass, from D.
☞ The subject upright again, in the soprano, in E minor.
☞ The last inversion, in the bass, from the middle of the bar.

listenFor: 3 voices; a lively gigue, its subject soon turned upside down
